name: Patrick PAT" Sweeney"
occupation: Self-employed; previous hotel and restaurant ownership. Wikipedia lists his profession as businessman.
education: B.S. in food service and hotel administration, Pennsylvania State University
background: Born June 16, 1954, in Jamestown, New York. A B.S. in food service and hotel administration from Penn State, prior hotel/restaurant ownership, Presbyterian affiliation, and membership in the Casper Downtown Business Association and Casper Area Chamber of Commerce. He served in the House from January 2017 to January 2023.
